### Sent to Bear Witness
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/sent-to-bear-witness-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-september-12-2017.html
Passage: John 1:8
Points:
- John the Baptist carried massive influence and national prominence in his day.
- He recognized that his calling was not to be the Light, but to testify about Christ.
- John refused to leverage his popular platform for wealth or selfish ambition.
- God works through human witnesses so that others may come to believe.
- Believers are called to take whatever influence they possess and point people to Jesus.

### The Strange Task of Witnessing About Light
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-strange-task-of-witnessing-about-light
Passage: John 1:7
Points:
- Unlike a physical lamp, Christ's spiritual glory shines through the proclamation of the gospel message.
- People are spiritually blind to Christ until God opens the eyes of their hearts.
- God sovereignly uses human witnesses as His chosen means to awaken spiritual sight.
- Proclaiming what Jesus accomplished on the cross enables hearers to see His true glory.
- Believers should witness boldly because God's supernatural power accompanies the gospel message.
